text:
Predicates:
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
HasTeeth(x) ::: x has teeth.
Platypus(x) ::: x is a platypus.
Humans(x) ::: x is a human.
Question:  
Based on the above information, is the following statement true, false, or uncertain? Platypuses are mammals with no teeth.  

Premises:  
Some mammals have teeth. ::: ∃x (Mammal(x) ∧ HasTeeth(x))  
Platypuses have no teeth. ::: ∀x (Platypus(x) → ¬HasTeeth(x))  
Platypuses are mammals. ::: ∀x (Platypus(x) → Mammal(x))  
Humans have teeth. ::: ∀x (Humans(x) → HasTeeth(x))  

Conclusion:  
∃x (Platypus(x) ∧ Mammal(x) ∧ ¬HasTeeth(x)) ::: Platypuses are mammals with no teeth.
